title: A fixed module resolution identifies sections homology with Ext
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $I$ an injective resolution of $F$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and $n\in\mathbb N$. The degree-$n$ homology of the global-sections complex $\Gamma(X,I^\bullet)$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] is additively equivalent to $\operatorname{Ext}^n(\mathcal O_X,F)$. If a cycle $a$ is obtained by evaluating a cocycle morphism $\varphi:\mathcal O_X\to I^n$ at $1$ on $X$, this equivalence sends the homology class of $a$ to the Ext class represented by $\varphi$. This concerns a fixed resolution only; it does not assert compatibility between resolutions or identify a derived-functor object.

source.place: Tags 01DZ (cohomology of modules) and 0B6A (Global derived hom; Ext as cohomology of derived global Hom)

proof.text: Use SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv and evaluation on the terminal open to identify maps from the unit sheaf with global sections additively. Construct the inverse by restriction from the terminal open. Naturality under postcomposition gives unitSectionComplexIso between the nonnegative Hom complex and the underlying abelian-group sections complex.

Map the kernel of the outgoing differential in the nonnegative Hom complex to Ext using InjectiveResolution.extMk. Mathlib add_extMk makes this additive and extMk_surjective makes it surjective. In degree p+1, extMk_eq_zero_iff identifies its kernel with the image of the preceding differential. In degree zero use extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk and fromSingleMk_mem_coboundaries_iff in degree -1: the injective resolution is zero there, so extMk vanishes exactly when the cocycle morphism is zero, as does the preceding differential. QuotientAddGroup.liftEquiv and ShortComplex.abHomologyIso yield injectiveResolution_homology_cocycle with its representative formula.

Transport the inverse of this Ext-to-Hom-homology equivalence through the homology of unitSectionComplexIso and ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for the module-to-abelian-group forgetful functor. The lemma forget_homologyπ follows from LeftHomologyData.mapHomologyIso_eq, mapCyclesIso_eq, and the homology projection identities. Given a cycle a and a cocycle morphism phi whose value at 1 equals iCycles(a), apply the composite forward equivalence. Naturality of cyclesMap and injectivity of iCycles identify the transported cocycle with a; naturality of homologyπ and forget_homologyπ then prove the requested formula. All constructions include degree zero, zero modules and the empty scheme.

from.place: Fixed-resolution component of the module-cohomology Ext comparison needed by field-linear cohomology operations

lean.statement:
theorem moduleResolutionHomologyExtEquiv (F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).homology n ≃+
        Abelian.Ext.{u} (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) F n,
      ∀ (a : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).cycles n)
        (φ : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ I.cocomplex.X n)
        (hφ : φ ≫ I.cocomplex.d n (n + 1) = 0),
        φ.val.app (op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) =
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).iCycles n a →
        e ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).homologyπ n a) =
          I.extMk φ (n + 1) rfl hφ
